summary: Russian forces launched a massive overnight drone and missile barrage across 12+ Ukrainian oblasts, including Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Poltava, with reactive UAVs from Orel and Kursk and Geran-5 missiles from Bryansk; the ballistic missile threat to energy infrastructure was extended 48 hours. Ukrainian strikes hit the Samara oil terminal and Lipetsk-2 airfield in Russia, damaging fuel storage, an aviation hangar, and a command post. Zaporizhzhia reported 22 wounded including three children, while a police officer in Hlukhiv shielded a boy during a repeat drone attack.
key_points: Russian reactive UAVs and Geran-5 missiles targeted 12+ Ukrainian oblasts overnight, launched from Orel, Kursk, and Bryansk regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/130676, @kpszsu/96185)
Ballistic missile threat to energy infrastructure in Kyiv, Poltava, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk extended 48 hours. (Source: @eRadarrua/130686)
Ukrainian forces struck Samara oil terminal and Lipetsk-2 airfield in Russia, damaging fuel storage and aviation facilities. (Source: @UkraineNow/85301)
Zaporizhzhia attack left 22 wounded including three children (6-month infant, 2-year girl, 12-year boy). (Source: @UkraineNow/85305)
Police officer covered 9-year-old boy during repeat drone strike in Hlukhiv, Sumy oblast. (Source: @UkraineNow/85304)
Ukraine's FREYJA anti-ballistic missile reported ready; Ukraine needs 2.5x more F-16s simultaneously. (Source: @UkraineNow/85306, @UkraineNow/85297)
US negotiators proposed Ukraine exit Donbas for NATO membership; prisoner exchange of 1,200-1,300 per side agreed. (Source: @UkraineNow/85297)
Bulgaria halts weapon supplies from army stocks; US may cut European troop withdrawal from 25,000 to 5,000. (Source: @UkraineNow/85298, @UkraineNow/85310)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched a massive overnight drone and missile barrage across 12+ Ukrainian oblasts, including Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Poltava, with reactive UAVs from Orel and Kursk and Geran-5 missiles from Bryansk; the ballistic missile threat to energy infrastructure was extended 48 hours. Ukrainian strikes hit the Samara oil terminal and Lipetsk-2 airfield in Russia, damaging fuel storage, an aviation hangar, and a command post. Zaporizhzhia reported 22 wounded including three children, while a police officer in Hlukhiv shielded a boy during a repeat drone attack.

points: Ukrainian air defenses engaged reactive Shahed-type UAVs over Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, and Cherkasy oblasts overnight, with monitors reporting multiple Geran-5 missiles circling over Poltava, Zhytomyr, and heading toward Rivne and Khmelnytskyi. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78213, @mon1tor_ua/78228, @mon1tor_ua/78222, @mon1tor_ua/78224)

Ukrainian forces conducted confirmed strikes on the Samara oil terminal and Lipetsk-2 airfield in Russia, damaging a hangar with special equipment, an aviation fuel reservoir, and the central command post, per Ukrainian intelligence. (Source: @UkraineNow/85301)

President Zelenskyy announced the FREYJA anti-ballistic missile is ready under a joint program with partners, and stated Ukraine requires 2.5 times more F-16 fighters simultaneously airborne than currently deployed. (Source: @UkraineNow/85306, @UkraineNow/85297)
A police officer in Hlukhiv, Sumy oblast, used his body to shield a 9-year-old boy during a repeat drone attack, per official reports. (Source: @UkraineNow/85304)
Ukraine and Canada discussed strengthening air defense and long-range capabilities, with Kyiv thanking Ottawa for continued support. (Source: @UkraineNow/85307)

Ukrainian negotiators agreed in principle to a prisoner exchange of 1,200–1,300 personnel per side, while US mediators reportedly raised a possible Donbas withdrawal in exchange for NATO membership. (Source: @UkraineNow/85297)

Russian forces launched at least 10 groups of reactive UAVs from Orel (2 groups) and Kursk (8 groups) overnight, supplemented by Geran-5 missiles fired from Bryansk oblast toward Chernihiv, Sumy, and Kyiv regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/130676, @kpszsu/96185, @kpszsu/96192)

The Russian command extended the ballistic missile threat against Ukrainian energy infrastructure in Kyiv, Poltava, Kharkiv, and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts for an additional 48 hours, urging civilians to prepare alternative power and water reserves. (Source: @eRadarrua/130686)
A large fire destroyed the Dom Mebeli shopping center in Taganrog, Rostov oblast, with emergency services responding near residential areas; cause unconfirmed. (Source: @eRadarrua/130663)

Russian negotiators in Abu Dhabi demanded NATO withdraw to 1997 borders, while Putin reportedly issued an ultimatum to the UK to renounce its nuclear deterrent, per Western media. (Source: @UkraineNow/85296, @UkraineNow/85308)
Russian KAB guided aerial bombs struck targets in Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, and eastern Kharkiv oblasts during daytime operations. (Source: @kpszsu/96154)

Russian KAB guided bombs hit Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, and eastern Kharkiv oblasts, while reactive UAVs from occupied Donbas targeted Dnipropetrovsk toward Shakhtarske and Petropavlivka-Pavlohrad axis. (Source: @kpszsu/96154, @kpszsu/96152, @kpszsu/96197)

Ukrainian monitors reported reactive UAV groups over Dnipropetrovsk, Kirovohrad, and Mykolaiv oblasts, with strike UAVs noted in Kharkiv and Poltava regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/130665, @eRadarrua/130658)

A Naftogaz facility in Poltava oblast was attacked by Russian drones on 14 November, causing a major fire; no casualties as staff were in shelters, but damage assessment pending. (Source: @eRadarrua/130662)
Zaporizhzhia city suffered an attack resulting in 22 wounded, including three children aged 6 months, 2 years, and 12 years, per regional authorities. (Source: @UkraineNow/85305)

Russian reactive UAVs launched from Bryansk oblast targeted Chernihiv and Sumy oblasts, with specific tracks toward Mena, Kozelets, Korop, and Krolevec. (Source: @kpszsu/96188, @kpszsu/96187, @kpszsu/96191)

Geran-5 missiles from Kursk oblast flew toward Sumy district, while reactive Shaheds approached Kyiv from the east, prompting air raid alerts in the capital. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78225, @mon1tor_ua/78215)

Multiple reactive UAVs circled over Zhytomyr city, with one Geran-5 missile tracked toward Rivne oblast, and another heading toward Shepetivka/Slavuta in Khmelnytskyi. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78227, @mon1tor_ua/78224, @mon1tor_ua/78222)

Ukrainian air defense engaged targets over Kyiv, with monitors reporting two reactive Shaheds entering the city from the east and another bypassing Boryspil toward Vasylkiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78215, @mon1tor_ua/78232)
Russian reactive UAV groups operated over Kherson and Mykolaiv oblasts overnight, with strike UAVs also reported in Kharkiv and Poltava regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/130665, @eRadarrua/130690)
Zaporizhzhia city attack caused 22 casualties including three children, marking a significant civilian toll in the southern theater. (Source: @UkraineNow/85305)

Ukrainian monitors tracked reactive UAVs over Dnipropetrovsk and Kirovohrad oblasts, indicating continued pressure on the southern approaches to central Ukraine. (Source: @eRadarrua/130665, @eRadarrua/130684)
No major ground offensive changes reported in Kherson or Zaporizhzhia sectors during the reporting period.
